title: BE-SHEER KI GARDAN PAR JAB TEER LAGA HOGA
body:
BE-SHEER KI GARDAN PAR JAB TEER LAGA HOGA
Us Waqt Shah e Deeñ Ka Kya Haal Huwa Hogaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Dete Hue Asghar Ko Shabbir Ki Godi Me
Be-sheer Ka Baano Ne Muh Choom Liya Hogaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Be-Sheer Ki Nawek Se Gardan Jo Chidi Hogi
Zahra Ke Kaleje Me Nasoor Pada Hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Haathoñ Pe Ali Asghar Jab Kaanp Gaye Hoge
Zahra Ke Pisar Ka Bhi Dil Kaanp Gaya Hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch Ashk Giray Hoge Be-sheer Ki Turbat Par
Shabbir Ne Asghar Ko Jab Dafn Kiya Hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Maidan Me Jab Asghar Dam Tod Rahe Hoge
Us Waqt Me Baano Ko Ek Haul Huwa Hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya Dil Na Jalaa Hoga Us Waqt Me Baano Ka
Jhoola Ali Asghar Ka Jis Waqt Jala Hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
IsKi Bhi Khabar Hilmi Thi Dilbar e Zahra Ko
Be-Sheer Ka Turbat Me Sar Tann Se Judaa Hoga
